nodes.label: Official Interfaces Only Rule
nodes.rationale: Competition fairness and generalization depend on participants using only organizer-provided ROS interfaces rather than backend/simulator internals.

nodes.label: Zenoh ACL Enforcement
nodes.rationale: ACL blocks model-side access to privileged topics/services (e.g., gz_server state) to prevent cheating through hidden simulator state.

nodes.label: Controller Impedance Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Low-rate policy targets are clamped, interpolated, and converted into high-rate torque commands with impedance plus gravity compensation for safe contact-rich control.

nodes.label: aic_model Lifecycle Contract
nodes.rationale: Strict lifecycle timing/state requirements ensure submissions are evaluable, cancellable, and behaviorally consistent in automated orchestration.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Scoring Model
nodes.rationale: Scoring separates hard validity gating, trajectory-quality metrics, and task success/proximity outcomes to reward both safety and effectiveness.

nodes.label: Portal Silent Failure Modes
nodes.rationale: Silent portal failures are often caused by sim-time misuse or heavy top-level imports exceeding discovery timeout before configure.

nodes.label: Task Board Modular Randomization
nodes.rationale: Randomized rail-based placement forces perception-driven behavior instead of hard-coded coordinates.

nodes.label: Multi-Simulator Training Strategy
nodes.rationale: Gazebo is the official evaluator, while MuJoCo and Isaac Lab are promoted for robustness/domain-randomization during training.

nodes.label: Immutable Eval vs Mutable Model Boundary
nodes.norm_label: immutable eval vs mutable model boundary

nodes.label: RunACT and Example Policy CLI Commands
nodes.norm_label: runact and example policy cli commands

nodes.label: Source Build Workflow for Evaluation Stack
nodes.norm_label: source build workflow for evaluation stack

nodes.label: Proximity-First Scoring Strategy
nodes.rationale: Prioritize Tier 3 proximity to unlock Tier 2 points before attempting insertion robustness.

nodes.label: Visual-Motor Baseline First Path
nodes.rationale: Build a legal perception-to-motion baseline before training heavier learned policies.

nodes.label: Model-Agnostic Dataset Schema
nodes.rationale: Store raw observations and actions so ACT, Diffusion, and VLA training can reuse one dataset.

nodes.label: ACT-First Learned Policy Plan
nodes.rationale: ACT is selected first due to speed, lightweight training, and existing integration.

nodes.label: IsaacLab Non-Blocking Validation
nodes.rationale: Use IsaacLab as a multiplier only after Gazebo-validated transfer, not as the primary scoring truth.

nodes.label: No-Contact SFP Standoff Baseline
nodes.rationale: Aim for positive Tier 3 and safe Tier 2 unlock while avoiding contact penalties in first version.

nodes.label: Training-Only Ground-Truth Labeling
nodes.rationale: Ground-truth TF can generate labels/demos for training but must not be evaluation-time policy input.

nodes.label: Isolated Training Runtime Policy
nodes.rationale: Freeze code/env/runtime boundaries to prevent data-generation drift and process collisions.

nodes.label: Tiered Scoring Pipeline
nodes.rationale: The package builds two scoring tiers and dedicated entrypoints, indicating a tiered evaluation architecture.

nodes.label: Controller Target Mode Parameter
nodes.rationale: The controller explicitly switches accepted target type between cartesian and joint command modes.

nodes.label: Cartesian Impedance Parameter Set
nodes.rationale: The YAML defines stiffness, damping, wrench limits, nullspace, and feedforward interpolation for impedance control.

nodes.label: Joint Impedance Parameter Set
nodes.rationale: The YAML defines interpolator and default stiffness/damping vectors for joint-space impedance behavior.

nodes.label: Clamp-to-Limits Safety Parameters
nodes.rationale: Limits and tracking-error thresholds bound translation/rotation and clamp behavior under stalled error reduction.

nodes.label: Scoring Topic Subscription Manifest
nodes.rationale: The config enumerates required runtime topics and message types for scoring and event detection.

nodes.label: Trial Scene Definitions
nodes.rationale: Trials define task-board poses, spawned entities, cable placements, and mounting variants across scenarios.

nodes.label: Trial Task Definitions
nodes.rationale: Each trial includes task-level cable/plug/port targets with time limits for evaluation.

nodes.label: LeRobot Teleoperation Workflow
nodes.rationale: The workflow maps teleop devices to controller target modes and frame IDs for keyboard/SpaceMouse/joint commands.

nodes.label: LeRobot Recording Workflow
nodes.rationale: Recording commands bind teleop settings, task prompts, and dataset metadata for imitation data collection.

nodes.label: LeRobot Training Workflow
nodes.rationale: The package delegates policy learning to LeRobot training commands and tutorials after dataset collection.

nodes.label: Target Mode Requirement Rationale
nodes.rationale: The README states --robot.teleop_target_mode must be set because AICRobotAICController cannot infer it from --teleop.type.

nodes.label: AIC Isaac Lab Integration Workflow
nodes.rationale: The integration defines host setup, containerized execution, asset placement, and Isaac Lab task usage for AIC.

nodes.label: AIC-Task-v0 Environment
nodes.rationale: The README presents AIC-Task-v0 as the reference environment for teleop, demo capture, replay, and RL.

nodes.label: Isaac Lab Teleoperation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Teleoperation is executed via isaaclab scripts with keyboard device and camera options for data generation.

nodes.label: Isaac Lab Demo Recording Workflow
nodes.rationale: record_demos.py and replay_demos.py define capture and playback of task demonstrations.

nodes.label: Isaac Lab RL Training Workflow
nodes.rationale: The workflow trains policies through rsl_rl/train.py on AIC-Task-v0 in the container.

nodes.label: Future SDF-to-USD Export Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Future work explicitly plans adding an SDF world to USD asset export pipeline.

nodes.label: Zenoh Transport Configuration
nodes.rationale: The model container is configured for rmw_zenoh_cpp with eval as router endpoint for cross-container ROS traffic.

nodes.label: Scoring Failure Messages
nodes.rationale: The default result file captures tier-wise failure states such as model validation or task execution failure.
